children: An Amazon.com cargo plane overshot the runway at Miami International Airport and crashed into nearby vehicles before bursting into flames and sending dark clouds of black smoke into the air.
Miami-Dade Fire Rescue said more than 60 units rushed to the scene and firefighters were working to put out the fire and "assessing patients."
The airport was put into a ground stop at approximately 2 p.m., with all runways and taxiways currently closed.
Video shared on social media showed a crashed plane with the Amazon logo on the tail engulfed in plumes of black smoke.

The Boeing 767-300 cargo aircraft departed from Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport in San Juan, Puerto Rico, the Federal Aviation Administration said in a statement, adding that it will investigate.
Amazon didn't have an immediate comment.
